notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ends 2025-08-31), governmental funds only, no business-type funds. Basic statements use the Total Governmental Funds column on Exhibit D (p5), which is net of the reclassification column (transfers eliminated: 85,630 General to Other Governmental and 4,047,060.03 among General Fund components). Cash basis: beginning/ending_cash are the fund balances the statement rolls forward (cash in bank plus cash at county treasurer); fund balances left null. Reconciles: 15,680,434.25 + 37,870,803.75 - 27,651,764.12 = 25,899,473.88; the printed receipts total includes Issuance of bonds 9,958,161.50 (9,500,000 bonds + 458,161.50 premium, p16), recorded in debt_proceeds, so receipts items sum to 27,912,642.25. 'Taxes: Other' 4,947,737.25 split into state aid (homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate motor vehicle) and other taxes (carline, nameplate, railroad) using Exhibit G, L, M, N (ties exactly). 'County receipts' split using code 2110 county fines 126,932.60 (fines and forfeitures) and 2210 ESU receipts 7,216.33. 'Non-revenue receipts' 228,697.08 split into insurance adjustments 20,062.46, sale of property 8,705 (p9), Depreciation Fund other 30,660 (p11) and Employee Benefit Fund other 169,269.62 (p12). 'Other support services' 1,798,591.80 split into School Nutrition 886,420.69 (food service) and Activities 912,171.11 (student activities), which sum exactly. 'Debt service' split into principal and interest/fees from Exhibits L, M, N. 'Other local receipts' 1,442,216.18 not split (activities receipts are about 65% of it); recorded as charges for services/fees with review. Detail: Exhibit F (General Fund components) not recorded to avoid double counting; Exhibit G/H/I schedules cover those funds. General Fund expenditures use Exhibit P (program by object) for programs 1100-2120, which supersede the Exhibit G program lines; programs from 2130 onward come from Exhibit G (not itemized) because the trimmed PDF ends partway through Exhibit P (page 20, Guidance Services; remaining programs not trimmed). The General Fund spending lines contain 4,047,060.03 of transfers to the Depreciation and Employee Benefit Funds (Exhibit F reclassification column, p7), recorded as 13 negative contra lines by function group plus other financing -3,047,060.03 and -1,000,000; the receiving funds show matching transfers in (p11, p12). The General Fund 8000 Transfers 85,630 is an other financing line (-85,630) inside the printed expenditure total (includes other financing). Activities Fund (Exhibit J) is recorded account by account; the 85,630 General Fund transfer is inferred to sit inside its receipts (fund schedule receipts total exactly equals the statement total including transfers), recorded as a contra line and other financing. Activity and Nutrition and Cooperative funds' budgets are fund totals only, so budget_final is null on those lines. Dashes in budget columns recorded as 0. Exhibit P second 'Special Education Ages 0-2' heading (5,220.89) matches 1295 Special education unified sports in Exhibit G; heading as printed. Read pages 1-20 of 20
